name: The Slop Bowl is late
author: Frontier Lab Tycoon
description: The lab's lunch order, from the researchers' favourite place, is three days late. Everyone gets hangry, research goes backwards, the Aura drops, the tracker's ETA keeps slipping, and then the bowls arrive. FLT-109. FLT-15 section shape, direct-loaded.

add.title: Lunch is a day late
add.body: The Fancy Healthy Healthy Healthy Healthy Slop Bowl order for the whole lab is a day late. The tracker says the courier is "having a moment". Your researchers are standing at the gate, and the model is getting worse out of spite.

choices.label: Wait. It's worth it.
choices.hint: Free · research slides backwards until the bowls come

choices.label: Order a backup bowl from the same place
choices.hint: −$15K · it will also be late · two bowls each

slopbowl.place: Fancy Healthy Healthy Healthy Healthy Slop Bowl

lines: Order for... Fancy Healthy Healthy Healthy Healthy Slop Bowl?
That's us. It's been three days.
Traffic. Also I went to the other lab first.

toast.text: Lunch is late. The Fancy Healthy Healthy Healthy Healthy Slop Bowl tracker says the courier is "nearby".

thoughts: It said noon. It's noon.
The tracker has said "nearby" for a while now.
I paid extra for the fourth Healthy.
Lunch should be here by now. I can feel it.

toast.text: Day 2 of the Slop Bowl being late. Your researchers are hangry, and research is going backwards.

news: {lab} researchers report "vibes-based hunger" as lunch order passes one day late
Sources inside {lab}: nobody has trained anything since lunch, and several things have been un-trained
thoughts: Hangry is a valid research methodology.
If lunch isn't here soon I'm deleting the eval suite.
Staring at the gate makes it come faster. That's just science.
I can smell the bowls from here. I can't, actually. That's the problem.
I just reverted three commits out of spite. Not mine.
posts: lunch is a day late and i have started reverting commits. not mine. just commits
the Fancy Healthy Healthy Healthy Healthy Slop Bowl tracker has said "having a moment" for 24 hours. a MOMENT
hot take: hunger is a form of alignment pressure. cold take: where is my bowl
currently doing gradient ascent on my own frustration
every model i train while hungry comes out slightly meaner. this is not a metaphor. this is a bug report
rivals: Our researchers had lunch at noon. Just a reminder that operational excellence starts in the cafeteria.
Thinking of everyone at {lab} today. We have a chef. Two, actually.

news: Lunch delivery to {lab} now two days late; tracker says the courier "has entered a period of reflection"
{lab} training run loses a day of progress as researchers "forget what a gradient is" waiting for lunch
thoughts: The tracker moved! Away.
I have un-learned linear algebra.
One more "period of reflection" and I'm leaving to found a sandwich lab.
We're pacing in shifts now. I'm on second pacing.
Is quinoa a seed or a grain? I'd eat either.
posts: day 3 of the bowls. we have started a reading group about the bowls
just watched a senior researcher try to fine-tune a kombucha
update: we are now pacing at the gate in shifts
if the bowls don't come soon i'm open-sourcing the hunger
rivals: Wishing a speedy lunch to the folks at {lab}. Our evals went up 4% after the salad bar opened. Unrelated, probably.
Hearing {lab} is training backwards this week. Bold research direction.
Our lunch arrived at 11:58. We also shipped twice before dessert.

toast.text: Day 3 of the Slop Bowl being late. Two researchers are lying on the floor "to save energy".

news: Day 3: {lab} researchers lie down at the gate in what one calls "a low-power mode"
thoughts: I'm not lying down. I'm horizontally scaling.
Wake me when there are bowls.
The floor is warm. The floor understands.
rivals: Thoughts and prayers to {lab}'s researchers, who we hear are now on the floor. Our floor has a snack drawer.

beat.caption: Three days late, the Fancy Healthy Healthy Healthy Healthy Slop Bowl arrives
beat.sub: One courier. One bag. No apology.

news: Fancy Healthy Healthy Healthy Healthy Slop Bowl reaches {lab} three days late; researchers call the quinoa "worth it" and "rude"
thoughts: IT'S HERE.
Is that... a bowl?
I'm not crying, I'm hungry.

toast.text: The bowls are here. Everyone is eating, and research is going forwards again, fast: nobody focuses like a researcher who has just eaten.

thoughts: Worth it.
This is the healthiest I have ever been, for about eleven minutes.
Four Healthys. I counted.
I'm going to finish this run. Then this bowl. Then the run again.
I forgive everyone. Except the tracker.
posts: the bowls are here. i forgive everyone. except the tracker
post-lunch me would like to apologise for pre-lunch me's last six posts
update: fed. the model is learning again. so am i

thoughts: This granola is 40% seeds and 60% regret.
Emergency granola. Tastes like a compliance training.
It's not lunch. But it's not nothing.

toast.text: Both orders arrived at once. Every researcher has two bowls. The Vibes are immaculate.

thoughts: Two bowls. This is the best day of my career.
The backup was also three days late. Consistency is a feature.

hangry.status: Your courier is having a moment

worse.status: Your courier has entered a period of reflection

meltdown.status: Your courier is asking what lunch really means

arriving.status: Your courier is at the gate

fed.status: Delivered three days late. Rate your courier: ★★★★★ (mandatory)
